Speaking of Chelsea... Elon Musk's lawyer is joining Tom Brady in buying a stake in Chelsea. Hello, good afternoon and welcome to another Saturday clockwatch! The Premier League is back and there have been a few changes since the start of the international break.
One of those changes saw Crystal Palace sack Pierre Sage and appoint Thomas Frank as their new manager. We'll see him in action for the first time when Palace travel to face Coventry City.
Elsewhere, Chelsea host Leeds United at Stamford Bridge, Tottenham face Ipswich Town, Sunderland travel to face Aston Villa and Bournemouth take on Nottingham Forest.
We'll also be keeping tabs on what's happening in the Championship and across the EFL as well as the Scottish Premiership.
Kick-off everywhere is at 3pm GMT - join us!

Let's take a look at the scores...
GOAL! Chelsea 1-4 Leeds United (Brenden Aaronson, 90+1)
Aaronson makes it FOUR for Leeds United!
The winger is played through and makes a run into the box before cutting back and finding a gap between Emiliano Martínez and the near post.
League One: What a comeback from Oxford United! After being 3-0 down, they now lead Wycombe 4-3 thanks to a 95th-minute strike from Gatlin O'Donkor!
The full-time whistles are beginning to sound across the grounds. We'll bring you the results shortly...
GOAL! Coventry City 3-2 Crystal Palace (Dwight McNeil OG, 85)
That could be the winner!
McNeil deflects the ball into his own net to give Coventry the lead once again!
Scottish Premiership: Aberdeen have restored their two-goal lead against Kilmarnock thanks to Findlay Marshall. Four minutes of normal time left to play and that should wrap up the win.
There are roughly five minutes left plus added time in these 3pm fixtures. Still time for plenty more goals.
Championship: George Thomason scores to put Wrexham 1-0 up against Lincoln. Meanwhile, Matt Godden has got one back for Charlton against Wolves to make it 2-1 with eight minutes to play.
League One: And there's the equaliser! From 3-0 down, Oxford United have scored three goals in eight minutes to go level against Wycombe.
Mark Harris gets the latest goal.
League One: Oxford United get another goal back against Wycombe thanks to a Cameron Brannagan penalty - could we see a stunning comeback? It's currently 3-2 with 10 minutes to play.
Wycombe are also down to NINE players following red cards for Dan Casey and Luke Leahy.

Scottish Premiership: Killian Phillips scores a penalty to get a goal back for St. Mirren against Celtic.
League One: Oxford United get a goal back against Wycombe to close the gap and make it 3-1. Elsewhere, Stockport go 2-0 up against Cambridge and Leyton Orient extend their lead to 4-1 against AFC Wimbledon.
Championship: Luca Bombino receives a red card and Stoke are down to 10 men. They lead 1-0 but there are more than 25 minutes still to play.
GOAL! Chelsea 1-3 Leeds United (Noah Okafor, 58)
Okafor gets his second of the game and Leeds have a two-goal advantage!
The forward has four Chelsea defenders around him inside the box but manages to find the bottom-right corner with his shot.
Championship: Konstantinos Mavropanos equalises for West Ham against Preston at London Stadium.
Meanwhile, Jordan Ayew makes it 3-0 to Sheffield United against Watford.
Scottish Premiership: Tyreece John-Jules scores for Kilmarnock to close the gap and make it 3-2 against Aberdeen. We could be in for a thrilling end to that game!
GOAL! Chelsea 1-2 Leeds United (Dominic Calvert-Lewin, 53)
Calvert-Lewin scores the penalty and Leeds take the lead!
That's his 100th club career goal. A huge milestone.
Leeds have a penalty against Chelsea following a handball from Morgan Rogers.
GOAL! Tottenham 2-0 Ipswich Town (Dominic Solanke, 52)
Solanke doubles the advantage!
Williams-Barnett makes a brilliant run down the wing before crossing into Solanke, who taps the ball home from a few yards out.
Championship: George Hirst gives Stoke a 1-0 lead against Birmingham early in the second half, while Adam Armstrong fires Wolves ahead against Charlton.
